description: A stone hut on the east shoulder, one room, one window, one chair. A float on a wire goes down through a pipe in the floor to the water and up to a drum of paper on the wall, and a pen on an arm draws the level across the paper as the drum turns, driven by a weight on a cord that somebody winds every day. There are years of these charts rolled and labelled on a shelf. The pen has ink in it.
name: The Gauge House
